latest.title: Khovanov monodromy groups via motions
latest.abstract: For any link, we define a monodromy map from the motion group of the link to the group of automorphisms of the link's Khovanov homology. The image of this map is the \emph{unoriented monodromy group} of the link. This map allows us to convert results concerning motion groups of links into ones about their Khovanov monodromy. In particular, we use a characterisation of the motion groups of split links to write their unoriented monodromy groups as an explicit semidirect product in terms of their unsplit pieces. We give some demonstrative examples, computing the unoriented monodromy groups of unlinks, Hopf links, and split links composed of pieces thereof.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 定义从链环运动群到 Khovanov 同调自同构群的单值映射，并用分裂链环运动群结构给出其无定向单值群的半直积分解及若干例子。
latest.breakthrough: 把几何运动群信息系统转译为 Khovanov 同调上的群作用，建立新的可计算链不变量层次。
latest.limitations: 当前计算集中于 unlink、Hopf link 及其分裂组合；对一般素链环的像与忠实性仍未知。
latest.priorityReason: 连接运动群与同调不变量，方向新颖但当前应用范围仍以示例和分裂情形为主。
